controller.description: The Zavbox TV menu is driven with a phone D-pad plus A, B and Home. After Play, the game must offer its own phone join, the way Party Mode does with its QR code.

games.title: Party Mode
games.description: Open-world off-road driving. Play solo on the 512 m map, or start a party on the 2 km world. Phones steer and a TV is the shared screen.
games.coverAlt: Cinematic key art of a stylised orange off-road car on a night road, with neon light and mountains ahead.
games.artAlt: An orange 4x4 parked on a gravel track in Party Mode, with hills and trees ahead.
games.notes: Opens on this TV. On that screen, choose Party Mode, then scan the QR code it shows with your phone to drive. Zavbox steps aside once the game starts.

games.title: Air Tennis
games.description: Stadium tennis you play with your body. Prop your phone up 2-3 m away and its camera tracks one or two players: your arm is the racket. 1P vs CPU, 2P Match, 2P Rally, Doubles, Training and more.
games.coverAlt: Key art of a sleek mannequin-style player smashing a glowing neon ball in a dark indoor arena with cyan court lines.
games.artAlt: Air Tennis in play: a player on a deep-blue court with glowing cyan lines, hitting a neon ball.
games.notes: Opens on this TV. Scan the QR code Air Tennis shows with your phone, tap Start camera, prop the phone up with your whole body in view, and follow the quick setup.

games.title: LibreCorsa
games.description: A free, open-source racing simulator in the browser, made by its own developers. 500 Hz physics, AI races, multiplayer, and support for a keyboard, gamepad, touch screen or wheel. Opens on their site, not inside Zavbox.
games.credit: LibreCorsa — by its authors, open source
games.notice: LibreCorsa is a free, open-source game made by its own developers, not by Zavbox. You're leaving Zavbox to play it on librecorsa.org.
games.coverAlt: Original key art of a white and amber prototype race car on a wet twilight circuit, with a dark sky ahead.
games.notes: This is not a Zavbox game. After the short notice, this TV leaves Zavbox and opens librecorsa.org. LibreCorsa has its own keyboard, gamepad, touch and wheel controls on that site.
